question: ‘The Commonwealth of Cricket: A Lifelong Love Affair with the Most Subtle and Sophisticated Game Known to Humankind’ is a book written by _____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ramachandra Guha.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **“The Commonwealth of Cricket****: A Lifelong Love Affair with the Most Subtle and Sophisticated Game Known to Humankind** **” is a memoir of an Indian cricket fan by Ramachandra Guha.**
 
• The book is** about an Indian cricket fan** and describes his cricketing
